reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program encoding Alaska law (2021) and the scenario.

    Question: Does the law require landlords to provide a reason for eviction when giving tenants notice to vacate?

    Statute translated:
    - AK Stat  09.45.105 (2021): "Notice to quit ... must ... state ... the nature of the breach ... or other reason for termination ..."
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (the statement)
% -----------------------------

scenario_state(alaska).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The question scenario: a landlord is giving a tenant notice to vacate (i.e., a notice to quit).
scenario_notice_type(notice_to_quit).
scenario_actor(landlord).
scenario_recipient(tenant).
scenario_action(giving_notice_to_vacate_property).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario is satisfied (as encoded above).
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(alaska),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_notice_type(notice_to_quit),
    scenario_actor(landlord),
    scenario_recipient(tenant),
    scenario_action(giving_notice_to_vacate_property).

% -----------------------------
% Statute encoding (deterministic)
% -----------------------------

/*
  AK Stat  09.45.105 (2021) - Notice to quit contents requirement.
  We encode the portion relevant to the question:
   - The notice to quit must state the nature of the breach/violation OR other reason for termination.
*/
statute_ak_09_45_105_applies(State, Year, NoticeType) :-
    State = alaska,
    Year = 2021,
    NoticeType = notice_to_quit.

% Duty: notice must state a reason (breach/violation or other reason for termination).
legal_notice_must_state_reason(State, Year, NoticeType) :-
    statute_ak_09_45_105_applies(State, Year, NoticeType).

/*
  For completeness, we also encode the other listed "must" elements, even though not needed
  to answer the question.
*/
legal_notice_must_include_termination_datetime(State, Year, NoticeType) :-
    statute_ak_09_45_105_applies(State, Year, NoticeType).

legal_notice_must_direct_quit_by_termination(State, Year, NoticeType) :-
    statute_ak_09_45_105_applies(State, Year, NoticeType).

legal_notice_must_warn_of_civil_action_if_holdover(State, Year, NoticeType) :-
    statute_ak_09_45_105_applies(State, Year, NoticeType).

% -----------------------------
% Reasoning for the question
% -----------------------------

% In this scenario, determine whether the law requires stating a reason in the notice to vacate.
scenario_law_requires_reason_for_notice_to_vacate :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_notice_type(NoticeType),
    legal_notice_must_state_reason(State, Year, NoticeType).

% -----------------------------
% Final answer predicate (deterministic)
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_law_requires_reason_for_notice_to_vacate,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law require landlords to provide a reason for eviction when giving tenants notice to vacate the property?
